name: PdxNavMenu
description:
A vertical navigation menu for sidebars, with nested collapsible groups, an active entry and a
collapsed icon-only mode.
generics: T extends { key: string; label: string }

members.name: collapsed
members.description: Collapsed mode (show only icons, hide labels)

members.name: iconSet
members.description: Icon set name (for pdx-icon set attribute)

members.name: label
members.description:
The navigation landmark's accessible name. Empty: «Navigation». Two menus on a page need
two names, or a screen-reader user cannot tell the landmarks apart (#1023).

members.name: size
members.description: `sm`: a compact menu — smaller type, icons, chevrons and row padding, for a dense sidebar.

members.name: indicator
members.description: How the current entry is marked: `fill` tints it; `border` also draws a bar on its start edge.

members.name: chevron
members.description: Where a group's chevron sits: before its icon, or at the end of its row.

members.name: actions
members.description: `overlay`: the `actions` slot is laid over the row's end and shown on hover and focus, taking no width at rest.

members.name: toggleGroup
members.description: Expand or collapse one group by key. It selects nothing.

members.name: expandAll
members.description: Expand every group that has children, at any depth.

events.name: pdx-select
events.description: An entry was chosen; cancellable, so an app under the router navigates itself.
events.detail: { key: string; item: T; href?: string }

events.name: pdx-toggle
events.description: A group was folded or unfolded: its `key` and whether it is open now. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.description: Collapsed mode (show only icons, hide labels)

attributes.name: iconset
attributes.description: Icon set name (for pdx-icon set attribute)

attributes.name: label
attributes.description:
The navigation landmark's accessible name. Empty: «Navigation». Two menus on a page need
two names, or a screen-reader user cannot tell the landmarks apart (#1023).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: `sm`: a compact menu — smaller type, icons, chevrons and row padding, for a dense sidebar.

attributes.name: indicator
attributes.description: How the current entry is marked: `fill` tints it; `border` also draws a bar on its start edge.

attributes.name: chevron

slots.name: item
slots.description: Renders one navigation entry, a group's included: a snippet `item(item, level, expanded, active)`.
slots.signature: (item: Exclude<T | (T extends { children?: readonly (infer C)[] } ? C | (C extends { children?: readonly (infer D)[] } ? D : never) : never), { type: 'header' | 'separator' }>, level: number, expanded: boolean, active: boolean)

slots.name: itemActions
slots.description: Controls BESIDE a leaf entry (a pin, an «open in a new tab»), in a `.pdx-nav-row` with its link, never inside it: a link may hold no interactive content. A snippet `itemActions(item, level, active)`, named apart from the `actions` prop.
slots.signature: (item: Exclude<T | (T extends { children?: readonly (infer C)[] } ? C | (C extends { children?: readonly (infer D)[] } ? D : never) : never), { type: 'header' | 'separator' }>, level: number, active: boolean)

cssParts.name: nav
cssParts.description: The `role="navigation"` element that holds the entries (`.pdx-nav`).

cssParts.name: item
cssParts.description: An entry, a link or a button; the current one is `aria-current="page"`, an open group's `aria-expanded="true"`.

cssParts.name: group
cssParts.description: The entries of an open group, or of a heading that folds (`role="group"`).

cssParts.name: heading
cssParts.description: A section heading, text or the button that folds its group.

cssParts.name: actions
cssParts.description: The `actions` slot's controls beside a leaf entry.

cssParts.name: flyout
cssParts.description: A collapsed menu's group, opened beside its icon (on `<body>`).

cssStates.name: collapsed
cssStates.description: `collapsed` is set: icons only, a group in a flyout.
